steps.description: Bucket values, oldest first. The last is the current bucket, still filling.

lastStepAt.description: When the last bucket began, so a view can align the series of different rows.

self.description: The desktop this model is read on.

count.description: How many blockers wait, counted before any bound; this one is the first. Absent: one.

header.description: A question's header, bounded. Absent on a cut that carries no content (the phone's).

question.description: A question's prompt, bounded. Absent on a cut that carries no content.

detail.description: The blocker's own detail line, in the adapter's words, bounded. Absent on a cut that carries no content.

final.description: False while the reply is still streaming.

usd.description: Estimated API-equivalent USD for observed work, never an invoice.

burnPerHour.description: USD an hour, at the backend's current burn.

series.description: USD per step over the recent window (today 20 × 30 s).

name.description: A folder NAME, never a path (EL7 B1). Empty for a terminal in no project.

branch.description: Absent: nothing looked. Null: looked, and there is no branch.

seq.description:
The project's colour sequence, dealt the first time an agent runs in it.
The view host turns it into a colour with the theme; absent wears the
neutral ramp.

inputUsed.description: Lifetime input evidence for a host-owned interactive shell.

creationId.description: Opaque host birth correlation. Never an action or runtime identity.

id.description:
Stable identity. It survives a terminal being promoted to an agent and a
run resuming in a new terminal, so a view keys by this and nothing else.

createdAt.description: When the row was born, from whichever half of it knows.

stale.description: Not heard from lately. Presentation metadata, never a status.

alive.description: Still there: the host's liveness, or the runtime's own word.

observed.description:
The runtime has reported a state for this run. False while it starts, and while nothing drives it (with
`pending`). A terminal is always observed, by its host.

pending.description: Alive, but nothing drives it yet (a run that resumes at its next idle).

detail.description: The line under the name, in the backend's words (the toolkit holds the shared words, MV-D11).

activity.description:
What the row is doing now. An agent: the runtime's activity kind
(`starting`, `responding`, `reasoning`, `tool`, `delegating`, `compacting`,
`other`) and its line, bounded (absent on a cut that carries no content). A
terminal: its session's activity kind, and no line.

provider.x-ts-type: { readonly id: string; readonly label: string } | undefined

unread.description: A finished turn nobody has looked at yet: the backend's mark, cleared when any screen shows it.

profileSet.description: The Agent Profile SET it runs under (`native` for the machine's own).

attachable.description: A pane on the reading desktop can show it now.

writable.description:
Whether a pane on another desktop may type into this run, by its home desktop's policy (M41). The home backend
computes it once; today it equals `attachable`. It is tolerant data: no view derives write policy, and none draws
it, since every peer session is writable, the default and universal setting (James, 2026-10-28). A peer's row is
named by its desktop alone; what a viewer may do is decided at the attach, by the host.

isDefault.description: The desktop's default: letting go on the desktop itself opens this one.

blocked.description: An agent under it waits on the person.

signedIn.description: The agents signed in under it, in the host's order.

word.description: The state line under its bud, worded by the backend.

phrase.description: How the words say a faint desktop cannot take one, after its name.

profiles.description: Absent while they are being read.

spawn.description: Present only when the spawn menu changed.

from.description: Epoch ms, inside the window asked.

id.description: The model row it belongs to.

seamAt.description: The row's `statusSince` when the past was read. A view clips to the row's CURRENT `statusSince` too.

spans.description: Oldest first, never overlapping, all before `seamAt`.

id.description:
`past:<provider>:<native session id>`, never a model row's id, and never sent to the backend (a view may hand it
to its host's `openEnded`, TV-8).

provider.x-ts-type: { readonly id: string; readonly label: string } | undefined

title.description: The session's title for the name column (the record's); absent: the view names it by provider · project.

profileSet.description: The Agent Profile SET it ran under, when the host knew it: what a profile filter reads.

project.description: A folder name and its colour's sequence, as a live row's.

startedAt.description: Its birth: when the record began.

endedAt.description: Its last recorded activity (not an exit: the record holds no exit).

sinceMs.description: The window read, epoch ms; at most a day.

state.description:
`partial`: some of the record could not be read (or a re-read failed, and this is the last good one);
`unavailable`: a record should be here and cannot be read now. `detail` says why, in one sentence.

colour.description: The project's colour in the current theme; the neutral ramp for no project.

active.description: Mounted in the pane the person is working in.

receded.description: The host is showing another group (VibeField's profile tabs): it keeps its place and is drawn faint.

attachment.x-ts-type: { readonly panes: number; readonly colour?: string | undefined } | undefined
attachment.description: The panes showing it here, and the colour of the one it is worked in. Absent: mounted nowhere.

spawnHint.x-ts-type: { readonly x: number; readonly y: number } | undefined
spawnHint.description: Where the person asked for it, for views that place new arrivals spatially.

visualId.description:
The body this row continues, when its window knows it (window-local: the replica's `setLocal({ visualIds })`).
A launcher's agent takes the shell's place in its pane, so a spatial view keeps ONE body across the handoff
instead of a removal and an arrival. Absent: the row's own id. A view keys spatial identity by `visualId ?? id`.

agents.description: In the model's order: agents by birth, then bare terminals.

x-audit.scope: Backend MonitorAgentRow + window AgentView, model change/snapshot/spawn/history contracts, VibeField model wire/doors, 5 builtin monitor views, 10 builtin adapter declarations. iOS rendering parity is not audited here.
x-audit.completeness: Complete declared MonitorAgentRow/AgentView property tree and SDK model interface property inventory. Orthogonal state axes enumerated, not infinite Cartesian combinations. Per-view consumption is evidence-backed reviewed set; absence of a consumer is unknown unless explicitly ruled. Per-adapter raw ingestion is delegated; capability declarations are not empirical live-session proof.
